summary: This study compares different timings for giving the drug semaglutide by weekly injection to adults who have not lost enough weight one year after weight-loss surgery. Participants will be compared to others receiving a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the real treatment. The trial aims to see how well different treatment strategies work for weight loss over time. The trial has a status of Not yet recruiting and plans to enroll 100 participants.
